rule: FROZEN. Every user-facing message uses an ID from this scheme and follows the template. A message that does not name the object, the numbers and the next action is not acceptable.
id_scheme: MSG-<AREA>-<nnn>; AREA in BUD (budget), PRC (procurement), CAP (capitalisation), INT (integration), SEC (security/permission), GEN (generic)

template.structure: <What happened, with the specific object identified> <The numbers that matter> <What the user can do next>
must_contain: the object identifier (project, WBS, budget head, document number)
the shortfall or difference where relevant
at least one concrete next action
must_not_contain: bare error codes with no explanation
the words 'invalid', 'error occurred' or 'failed' without a reason
technical exception text shown to a business user
template.worked_exemplar_from_brief: The proposed PO value of 20,00,000 exceeds the available budget of 15,00,000 for WBS CAPEX-2026-001.03 by 5,00,000. Submit a budget revision or request exception approval.

placement_rules.field_level: Validation that concerns one field appears beneath that field and moves focus there.
placement_rules.form_level: An error summary appears at the top of the form listing every failed field as a link to it. Required for accessibility.
placement_rules.page_level: A message strip below the page header for conditions affecting the whole object, such as budget exceeded or integration failed.
placement_rules.toast: Confirmation of a completed action only. Never used for errors the user must act on, because it disappears.
placement_rules.dialog: Only for destructive or irreversible actions, and only with the consequence stated explicitly.

messages.text: The proposed {document_type} value of {amount} exceeds the available budget of {available} for {wbs_code} ({budget_head}) by {shortfall}. Submit a budget revision or request exception approval.
{wbs_code} has reached {utilisation} of its approved budget of {budget}. Exposure is {exposure} ({commitment} committed, {actual} actual). Review before approving further commitments.
{wbs_code} has reached {utilisation} of its approved budget of {budget}. Only {available} remains. Further commitments will require exception approval.

messages.trigger: Budget head missing on a capital transaction
messages.text: A CAPEX code and budget head are mandatory on capital procurement. Select a budget head for line {line_number} before submitting.

Revision {revision_number} approved by {approver} on {date}. Current approved budget for {wbs_code} is now {new_budget} (original {original_budget}, revisions {revision_total}). The original budget is unchanged.

messages.trigger: Budget transfer would leave a source with negative availability
messages.text: Transferring {amount} from {source_wbs} would leave it with negative availability of {resulting_available}, because {committed} is already committed. Reduce the transfer to at most {max_transferable}.
{po_number} has increased from {old_value} to {new_value}. The additional {delta} has been revalidated against {wbs_code}, where {available} is available.
{po_number} has been cancelled. Commitment of {released} has been released back to {wbs_code}. Available budget is now {available}.
{po_number} has been closed with {billed} billed against an ordered value of {ordered}. The unbilled residual of {residual} has been released back to {wbs_code}.

messages.trigger: Bill value exceeds the PO line it references
messages.text: Bill {bill_number} line {line_number} is {bill_amount} against purchase order line {po_line} of {po_amount}, an excess of {excess}. Confirm this is intended, or correct the bill before it is posted to CWIP.
{wbs_code} has {amount} received but not yet billed, the oldest for {days} days. This is included in exposure and will convert to actual CWIP when the vendor bills.

messages.trigger: Procurement attempted against a closed or capitalised project
messages.text: {project_code} is {status}. Procurement is not permitted. Request a controlled reopening, which requires {approver_role} approval and a recorded reason.

messages.trigger: Capitalisation requested while commitments remain open
messages.text: {project_code} has {open_commitment} in open commitments and {unbilled} received but unbilled. Resolve or explicitly write off these before capitalising, or the asset value will be understated.

messages.trigger: Capitalisation allocation does not total the CWIP balance
messages.text: The allocation totals {allocated} against a CWIP balance of {balance}, a difference of {difference}. Allocate the full balance across assets, or record the remainder as a write-off with a reason.
{project_code} capitalised on {date}. {balance} transferred from CWIP to {asset_count} fixed asset(s). The project is now Capitalised and closed to further procurement.
The connected Zoho organisation is missing the scope {scope}, required for {module}. {impact} Re-authorise the connection and grant this scope.

messages.trigger: Token revoked or expired beyond refresh
messages.text: The Zoho connection for {organisation_name} can no longer refresh its access token. Sync has been paused since {since}. Re-authorise to resume.
Zoho returned a rate-limit response for {organisation_name}. {pending} records are queued and will retry with backoff. No data has been lost.
{record_type} {record_id} failed {attempts} times and has been moved to the dead-letter queue. Last error: {error}. Review and replay once the cause is corrected.
Changing the mapped Zoho organisation from {current} to {proposed} will re-point every synced record. This requires {approver_role} approval and is recorded in the connector audit trail.
{object_type} {reference}: our value {our_value} differs from Zoho's {their_value} by {difference}, beyond the tolerance of {tolerance}. Investigate before relying on the affected report.
Your role ({role}) cannot {action} for {entity}. Contact {approver_role} if you need this access.
Your session will expire in {minutes} minutes. Save your work, or continue to stay signed in.
You are overriding {control} for {object}. A reason is mandatory and will be stored in the audit trail with your name and the current time.
{action} on {object} cannot be undone. {consequence} Type the {identifier_type} to confirm.

messages.trigger: Empty state on a filtered list
messages.text: No {object_type} match the current filters. Clear filters, or adjust the {primary_filter} to widen the search.
